name: hexen2
title: HEXEN II (Raven, mission-pack source, Win32 GL, id386=0)
fetch: (archive.org item hexen2-master: hexen2-master.zip, Raven's GPL release) unzip into corpus/
_doc: Raven's 2000 GPL release of Hexen II: the H2MP tree is the mission-pack source, which, as its info.txt says, contains the original game with the patch fixes. The unit list is Winquake.dsp's 'Win32 GL Release' configuration, read out of the project file (its SOURCE blocks minus Exclude_From_Build): 60 C files and 12 MASM files. The assembly is not translated: like Quake's, it is the id386=1 build, and Quakedef.h turns id386 on only under _M_IX86, which this target leaves undefined, so the C file beside each routine is the one compiled.
_caseInsensitive: A Windows tree on a Windows file system: the project file says cl_main.c and the disk says CL_MAIN.C, and glquake.h includes <gl\\gl.h> for GL/gl.h. Same flag as the DOS targets.
_defines: The GL Release configuration's /D flags (GLQUAKE WIN32 _WINDOWS QUAKE2RJ RJNET NDEBUG), plus _WIN32 as MSVC defines it. _M_IX86 deliberately absent (see _doc). _inline is an MSVC KEYWORD, the single-underscore spelling of __inline that Visual C++ 5 accepted (common.h declares Q_strcasecmp with it); a compiler built-in, so it is configuration here rather than a header macro.
_net: net_win.c's driver table names net_wins.c (TCP/IP) and net_wipx.c (IPX), both compiled as the project does, so Winsock is linked: win32-net.c over the wsock primitives, as Quake II's Win32 variant has it. IPX sockets are refused and that driver stands down.
